verdicts.reason: A: the food photos, which were the hero of the original, are now postage-stamp thumbnails in a row next to empty frame outlines, the decorative divider stroke and the pattern swatch float with no purpose, and the beige panel is gone. Its one strength is a large, clear headline. B: the same thumbnail strip with empty frames, plus a small, weak headline floating in the middle, two stray divider strokes, an isolated pattern square, and the brand block reordered so RESTAURANT sits under the URL. A edges ahead only because its headline hierarchy holds.
